findings.summary: Criterion 10 (Z3: two consecutive executions both reach a terminal state) is unreachable by construction, because auto-seed idempotency and the terminal-state assertion are mutually exclusive on the second run. Run 1 seeds the empty TICK_CHANNEL (scripts/e0-seed.mjs:83 seeds only when headSeq===0) and drives the card to a terminal status; every terminal status (explored/dropped/blocked, src/tick.ts:169 PENDING_CLUE_STATUSES) leaves the board with zero pending work. Run 2 then finds headSeq>0, so e0-seed returns {seeded:false,reason:'non-empty'} (scripts/e0-seed.mjs:83-89) and publishes nothing — correctly idempotent per criterion 5. But the board now holds only terminal cards, so the loop's first tick produces no dispatch/harvest/block decision and performs no CAS: bin/e0-verify.sh:56-59 fails Z1 ('head_seq did not grow') and bin/e0-regression.sh:216-222 returns 3. Criterion 5 (idempotent seeding, no doubled clues) and criterion 10 (both consecutive runs reach a terminal state, exit 0) therefore cannot both hold: whichever way the second run goes, one criterion fails. The entry has no re-seed-on-terminal-board path and no test drives the entry twice (the only repeat coverage, test/e0-regression.test.ts:598-643, re-runs e0-seed.mjs alone and asserts the skip, never the second full run's Z1/terminal outcome). This is the same 'entry can never reach a passing criterion by construction' shape that got attempts 1-5 rejected, now displaced from run 1 onto run 2.

Even on the first run, reaching a non-null termination.state depends on the loop performing at least three ticks, but the continuation that makes those ticks happen is gated on hasPendingWork, which goes false one tick too early for the single-seed board. decideTermination only yields a non-null state when zeroGrowthRounds >= zeroGrowthThreshold (2) with inFlight===0 and proposed===0 (src/tick.ts:383-390). The repo's own test acknowledges coverage is read before harvest and so lags a round (test/e0-regression.test.ts:834), and it needs a loop of up to 8 ticks with manually threaded --prev-coverage/--prev-zero-growth to reach 'converged' (test/e0-regression.test.ts:851-865). In the real entry, those extra ticks only occur if tick.md re-puts a trigger, which happens solely when run_output reports hasPendingWork true (workflows/deep-research/tick/templates/tick.md:96); once the harvested card is CASed to explored and no new clue is published, hasPendingWork(postWriteState)||cluesPublished>0 is false (src/tick-run.ts:1684), the drain ends, and the last observed termination.state is still null — which bin/e0-verify.sh:72-74 correctly treats as FAIL TERMINAL. The passing path asserted by the unit test is driven by hand-invoked tick-entry calls, not by the entry's own continuation wiring, so criterion 8 is not demonstrated end-to-end by the entry.

Non-blocking: tick.md still detects the continuation condition with a regex over the run_output JSON (grep -q '"hasPendingWork": *true') rather than a real JSON.parse. Spec §1.2 scopes the parse-don't-regex discipline to the three sed -n extractions in bin/e0-regression.sh (all correctly removed) and this is a single-valued boolean probe, so it is not the forbidden multi-value greedy extraction; but it is brittle against formatting changes in the printed outcome and would read more consistently via the node -e JSON.parse already used a few lines below at tick.md:103.

Non-blocking, and explicitly acknowledged: the two blockers named in spec §0 are genuinely fixed and well covered. head_seq is now read only from GET /v1/channels with real JSON parsing and a loud failure naming the channel and its actual field set (scripts/e0-metrics.mjs:83-98); sum is a true full sum with a discriminating test that the old greedy sed would fail (test/e0-metrics.test.ts:18-34); the fake bus now matches the real contract with single-channel GET omitting head_seq and a test that reddens if the E0a fiction returns (test/fixtures/fake-bus.mjs:97-111, test/e0-regression.test.ts:535-557); and the terminal-state reader correctly unwraps JournalEntry.result as an escaped string, matching the repo's own g15 journal fixture (scripts/e0-terminal-state.mjs:123-139). Criteria 6 and 7 also hold: board:agent-runs has a single source of truth at bin/e0-regression.sh:162, and no token plaintext appears in the repo.
